item.title: Kokuhaku Game
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Haitokudou
  • 発売日: 2022-11-23
  • スコア: 6.88/10 (134 人評価)
  • 日本語名: コクハクゲエム
  • 英語名: Kokuhaku Game

あらすじ

Spend four days in the game and clear it by confessing to your beloved, Shiori.

However, during that time, you must resist the temptations of the girls who use the “Confession Game” as their opportunity.

Preserve the protagonist’s chastity and make it to the final day.

※What is the Confession Game?

A game in which whoever confesses to the protagonist and receives an “OK” is declared the winner.

item.title: Shinda Hazu no Kanojo ~Kanojo de Nai "Nanika" ni Okasarete~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Haitokudou
  • 発売日: 2022-03-12
  • スコア: 6.1/10 (15 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 死んだはずの彼女～彼女でない“何か”に犯されて～
  • 英語名: Shinda Hazu no Kanojo Kanojo de Nai “Nanika” ni Okasarete

别名

  • She’s Supposed to Be Dead

あらすじ

Shinya Miura, who works in the city, lost his beloved girlfriend, Risa, in an accident two years ago.

One summer day, when Shinya returns home from a Bon vacation,

his friends and Risa’s parents, have the illusion that Risa is alive.
